$comment: Hand-maintained overrides only. Statuses Implemented/Tested/Complete are derived by tools/check_equicord_plugins.py and may not be set here. See docs/plugin-status.md.

verifiedInClient.notes: With role colors next to names, clicking the role dot after a name in a message and in the member list copied the role color (#206694).

Settings → Devices showed both devices with OS colours, platform badges and NEW; Rename on the phone showed "Test phone*" and cleared NEW, and Reset Name emptied the field (placeholder "iOS · Mobile Safari") so saving brought the default name back.
Sent a link with utm_source, utm_medium and fbclid; it arrived with only id=5 left.
Right-clicking the IK server's animated emoji in the picker showed Copy Emoji Markdown with the copy icon; it put <a:name:id> on the clipboard and showed the success toast.
Sent a .txt attachment; its copy button put the file's two lines on the clipboard.
Copy User Mention in a member's menu copied <@id>.
Copy User URL copied <https://discord.com/users/id>.
The hover-bar button showed "hello from Qord" for a message with aGVsbG8gZnJvbSBRb3Jk in it, and a right click copied it.
A <t:…:R> timestamp 160 s old showed "2 minutes ago" (rounding would show 3).

Without Nitro, an animated emoji from the server was offered by the picker and sent as a link; alone it showed as the emoji with its embed hidden, and hovering it showed the FakeNitro note. A 3,805-character message went out as two messages and a 2,902-character code block as two code blocks; an 18 MB PNG was attached as a 4.33 MB JPEG and sent. Not checked: fake stickers (the account is in one server only) and Go Live quality (UDP is blocked here). Round three (build a0b6b7c): with Fake reactions on, the reaction picker offered the server's animated emoji and picking it sent a reply holding it as a link; in #gagbot with Embed Links denied, a fake emoji went as a 128 px GIF attachment; text and two shift-clicked stickers went as one message; a 164 MB video showed a progress bar and Cancel stopped it, and with "The first 15 seconds" it was cut to 15 s (9.59 MB).

The colour settings picked #5865f2 and #eb459e, Copy 3y3 put " [#5865f2,#eb459e]" as tag characters on the clipboard, and Preview opened the account's own profile in a blue-to-pink gradient with the banner in the primary colour. Not checked live: another user's bio with the text in it (no account with one); decoding is covered by the plugin's test.
With the chat-bar toggle on, "ingtoninator check" was sent with "ington" added to a word; toggled off afterwards.

In #gagbot: double-click (Copy Link) copied the message link with the "Link copied!" toast; Backspace-click deleted the message, MessageLogger kept it in red, and a second Backspace-click took it off the screen without another request to Discord; with Open Thread, Backspace-click showed Create Thread with the message's text as the name (cancelled). Pick Emoji set the react emoji to 👍 and added ❤️ and 👀 to the additional list, ❤️ only once.
Blocking the other member hid all their messages in the channel; unblocking showed them again.
Replies started from the menu and with QuickReply showed @ OFF.
Copy Message Link went through the plugin and gave a discord.com link.
A desktop icon after the other member's name in messages and the member list.
"case test. second sentence here. im ok and dont worry" was sent as "Case test. Second sentence here. I'm ok and don't worry".

In #gagbot with "preview check" typed and an image pasted, the eye button showed the text and the image as an "Only you can see this" message; with the text cleared it previewed the image alone. Both were dismissed and nothing was sent.
Ctrl+Up replied to the newest message, again to the one before; Ctrl+Shift+Up started editing the last own message.
With #algemeen unread, Read All in the server list marked it read.
`17:59` was sent as a timestamp; the calendar button's picker inserted <t:…>.
With the toggle on, the sent message had flags 4096 (View Raw).

verifiedInClient.by: Maarten's test account, IK server (member list dots on the mock server)
verifiedInClient.notes: In #gagbot, /silent-typing was suggested as SilentTyping's; "/silent-typing chat-icon:false" removed the chat-bar icon and answered "Silent typing settings updated." as a message only you see, and the message box's right-click Silent Typing submenu showed the settings as checkboxes and Chat Icon brought the icon back. Nobody else was online in IK to type, so the member list dots were checked on the mock server: a typing member got the dots on their avatar, hidden with "Hide members list typing indicators" and shown again when it was unticked from the submenu.
With the toggle on, "reverse check" was sent reversed.
A brb → be right back rule: the rule tester and a sent message both read "ok be right back soon".

The hover-bar button showed the translation under the message with the translate icon and Dismiss; the settings button opened the languages window, and the DeepL key and Kagi session fields showed only for their service.
An 8-space indented code block was sent with the common indent removed.
The hover-bar button showed 25°C as 77.00°F under the message with the convert icon, leaving the Base64 word next to it alone.

The hover-bar button showed the message's content and data and a right click copied the content; View Raw showed the data of #algemeen, the IK server, a member, their profile (from its More button) and a role (from the profile), and appeared in the message menu with that setting on.
A reaction from the other member showed their avatar next to the count.
Sentences were sent with their first letters capitalised (same message as PolishWording).
